extension.description: Play all your media from OneDrive including Videos, Music and Pictures. - Unlimited number of personal or business accounts. - Search over your drive. - Auto-Refreshed slideshow. - Export your videos to your library (.strm files) - Use OneDrive as a source - This program is not affiliated with or sponsored by Microsoft.
extension.summary: כונן OneDrive של מיקרוסופט עבור קודי
extension.description: הפעל את כל המדיה שלך מ- OneDrive כולל וידאו, מוסיקה ותמונות. - מספר בלתי מוגבל של חשבונות אישיים או עסקיים. - חיפוש ומציאת הכונן שלך. - ריענון מצגת אוטומטית. - ייצוא קטעי הווידאו לספרייה שלך (קבצי .strm) - שימוש ב-OneDrive כמקור - תוכנית זו אינה מזוהה עם או בחסות מיקרוסופט.
extension.news:
v1.0.1: - Folder names containing a space, a # or a % now open. Before this, such a folder produced no request at all. - A video file is no longer also treated as an image, so it plays instead of opening in the picture viewer. - The shared Personal Vault now shows its name instead of a blank row, and opens in the drive that holds it. - Search works on a business drive. It previously failed outright, and afterwards ordinary browsing failed too until Kodi was restarted. - Very large folders no longer stop partway. Paging was rebuilt and is held to 1,500 pages. - Cancelling a slow listing now ends it cleanly instead of showing an error. - Thumbnails are fetched at a size suited to the row they are drawn in, rather than the largest available.
v1.0.0: - First release under a new add-on id, maintained independently of the original. - Signing in now goes straight to Microsoft: a code appears on screen and you enter it on your phone. It no longer passes through a third-party sign-in server. - Self-contained: the Cloud Drive common module is bundled, so no separate module add-on is needed. - Requires Kodi 20 or newer.
extension.disclaimer:
This add-on signs in with the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant, directly to Microsoft. It shows you a code; you enter that code on your own phone or computer, at the Microsoft address shown beside it, and Microsoft hands the token back to the add-on.
No server run by this project, or by anyone else, sits in that exchange, and the add-on never sees your password. The application identifier it ships with is public by design: that is what this kind of sign-in uses instead of a secret, it only says which program is asking, and on its own it authorises nothing. The permission asked for is read-only access to your own files.
This program is not affiliated with or sponsored by Microsoft. Kodi and myself take no responsibility or liability.
